validity_limits: the 48 mismatch draws were measured at TT/27 C; they are applied as per-chip RELATIVE factors at every corner (declared composition, not a MC re-run per corner)
full calibration is the continuous-trim upper bound (100 ppm floor, same declared readout bound as the IHP lane so the two processes are comparable); the real trim code range is B3

6v0 rows apply the 6V family's own measured relative factors to the same compiled descriptors: they answer 'if this architecture were built on 6 V devices, how would the corner sensitivity look', not 'the chip uses 6 V devices here'
poisson-2d is the 8x8 (64-state) mesh with the declared 1 ns model-time deadline mapped to alpha*1 ns (steady state); the 16x16 anchor is run_pipeline's workload
the step-response QoI is the operator-error proxy, not a nonlinear PDE re-run
MOS noise is measured here (unlike IHP's PSP103 OSDI gap), but it enters this lane only through the map, not through the QoI (the QoI is deterministic operator error)
